data.name: Sigil
data.description: Local-first C++20 signal daemon — a lock-free signal bus and rule engine connecting sensor/event sources to actions entirely on-device, no cloud round-trip.

data.name: HotelOps
data.description: Digital operations platform for a hotel chain — real-time room status board, GPS-verified staff clock-in, linen tracking, and cross-device sync across manager and housekeeping apps, replacing Excel sheets and a magnetic scheduling board.

data.name: NDHU Task Management
data.description: Full-stack mobile task management app — local-first Expo/React Native client with offline SQLite sync, and a C++ (Drogon) REST API backend with JWT auth and automatic Moodle LMS assignment import.

data.name: Maestro
data.description: Two-stream BiLSTM real-time hand-gesture recognition system for hands-free presentation control — MediaPipe Hands feature pipeline, PySide6 control UI, cross-platform packaged app. NDHU Undergraduate Project Excellent Award, 2026.

data.name: NDHU Second-Hand Book Store
data.description: Campus marketplace for NDHU students to buy and sell used textbooks. Led the Go/Fiber backend architecture and REST API design end to end, and integrated an AI-based book condition classification model into the pipeline.

data.name: JsonFS
data.description: C++ FUSE virtual filesystem that mounts JSON files and live REST APIs as a navigable POSIX directory tree — schema-enforced writes rejected at the syscall layer, atomic write-back, and live URL mounting with TTL refresh.
